name: Exposure Routes
summary: Pulls users & groups (navi primary, Tenable MCP backup) split into paginated Users/Groups, tracks ownership COVERAGE on plugins — every open finding zipped to its route and paths, which are the ways it gets assigned (own a route and its paths are covered; an asset is 'closed' when every open finding on it is owned), and maps exposure routes & paths to owners from plain English — tagging Owner:<group/user> on every asset on the matched route/path (gated).
